description: This file defines a custom Markdown renderer class 'RemoveMarkdown' that extends 'marked.Renderer'. It provides methods to process and strip Markdown syntax, converting it into plain text, with special handling for HTML entities and various Markdown elements.

classes.name: RemoveMarkdown
classes.description: A custom renderer class extending 'marked.Renderer' to convert Markdown to plain text, handling HTML entities and Markdown syntax.

methods.name: code
methods.description: Escapes HTML in code blocks and replaces newlines with spaces.

methods.name: blockquote
methods.description: Replaces newlines in blockquotes with spaces.

methods.name: heading
methods.description: Returns heading text with an appended space.

methods.name: hr
methods.description: Returns an empty string for horizontal rules.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list body as is.

methods.name: listitem
methods.description: Returns list item text with an appended space.

methods.name: paragraph
methods.description: Returns paragraph text with an appended space.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Returns an empty string for tables.

methods.name: tablerow
methods.description: Returns an empty string for table rows.

methods.name: tablecell
methods.description: Returns an empty string for table cells.

methods.name: codespan
methods.description: Replaces newlines in inline code spans with spaces.

methods.name: br
methods.description: Returns a space for line breaks.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Returns the link text, ignoring href and title.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Returns the alt text of the image, ignoring src and title.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Replaces newlines with spaces and decodes HTML entities to characters.
